properties.description: Sync Advisors to CRM account entity using staging pipeline and upsert

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) AS RecordCount FROM staging.Advisor_Staging WHERE SyncStatus = 'Processing'

SELECT [Advisor Code] AS new_advisorcode_advisor, LTRIM(RTRIM([First Name])) AS new_firstname_advisor, LTRIM(RTRIM([Last Name])) AS new_lastname_advisor, LTRIM(RTRIM([Account Name])) AS name, LTRIM(RTRIM([Business Name])) AS new_businessname_advisor, LTRIM(RTRIM([Account/Phone])) AS new_accountphone, LTRIM(RTRIM([E-mail])) AS emailaddress1, LTRIM(RTRIM([Federal BN])) AS new_federalbn, LTRIM(RTRIM([Provincial BN])) AS new_provincialbn, LTRIM(RTRIM([NRD_Number])) AS new_nrd_number, [Last_Modified_Date] AS new_datasynctimestamp, LTRIM(RTRIM([Address 1: City])) AS address1_city, LTRIM(RTRIM([Address 1: State/Province])) AS address1_stateorprovince, LTRIM(RTRIM([Address 1: ZIP/Postal Code])) AS address1_postalcode, LTRIM(RTRIM([Address 1: Country/Region])) AS address1_country, LTRIM(RTRIM([Address 1: Street 1])) AS address1_line1, LTRIM(RTRIM([Address 1: Telephone 2])) AS address1_telephone2, LTRIM(RTRIM([Address 1: Fax])) AS address1_fax, LTRIM(RTRIM([Web Site])) AS websiteurl, LTRIM(RTRIM([Ext])) AS new_ext, LTRIM(RTRIM([License #])) AS new_license_advisorlicense, [License Start Date] AS new_licensestartdate_advisorlicense, [License End Date] AS new_licenseenddate_advisorlicense, CAST([License Level] AS INT) AS new_licenselevel_advisorlicense, CAST([License Type] AS INT) AS new_licensetype_advisorlicense, LTRIM(RTRIM([Company_E & O])) AS new_company_errorsandommission, LTRIM(RTRIM([Policy #_E & O])) AS new_policyerrorsandommission, LTRIM(RTRIM([Coverage $_E & O])) AS new_coverage_errorsandommission, CAST([Coverage For_E & O] AS INT) AS new_coveragefor_errorsandommission, LTRIM(RTRIM([Sponsor])) AS new_sponsor_advisorlicenses, LTRIM(RTRIM([Premium $_E & O])) AS new_premium_errorsandommission, CAST([Premium Mode_E & O] AS INT) AS new_premiummode_errorsandommission, LTRIM(RTRIM([Deductible $_E & O])) AS new_deductible_errorsandommission, [Starting Date_E & O] AS new_startingdate_errorsandommission, [Ending Date_E & O] AS new_endingdate_errorsandommission, CAST([Alberta] AS BIT) AS new_alberta_advisor_license, CAST([British Columbia] AS BIT) AS new_britishcolumbia_advisor_license, CAST([Manitoba] AS BIT) AS new_manitoba_advisor_license, CAST([New Brunswick] AS BIT) AS new_newbrunswick_advisor_license, CAST([Newfoundland and Labrador] AS BIT) AS new_newfoundlandandlabrador_advisor_license, CAST([Northwest Territories] AS BIT) AS new_northwestterritories_advisor_license, CAST([Nova Scotia] AS BIT) AS new_novascotia_advisor_license, CAST([Ontario] AS BIT) AS new_ontario_advisor_license, CAST([Prince Edward Island] AS BIT) AS new_princeedwardisland_advisor_license, CAST([Quebec] AS BIT) AS new_quebec_advisor_license, AdvisorCRMGUID, OwnerCRMGUID, CONCAT('/systemusers(', OwnerCRMGUID, ')') AS ownerbind FROM staging.Advisor_Staging WHERE SyncStatus = 'Processing'
